notes.title: DoubleShake is an upcoming love letter to 5th generation console platformers
notes.content:
Currently crowdfunding on Kickstarter with a goal that's been hit, DoubleShake from Rightstick Studios is a love letter to classic 5th generation platformers.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/doubleshake-is-an-upcoming-love-letter-to-5th-generation-console-platformers
